text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"The day of the JBC Classic. Dirt 
powerhouses Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute 
are both entered in this race."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's still the early half of the 
autumn/winter season, so those two 
probably won't be in peak condition. 
Seeing this as an opportunity, she 
challenges the two superior rivals.
